en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wooded city park. A wide path leads toward a large tree with a circular, thatched, mushroom‑shaped shelter built around its trunk, with benches underneath. Dense foliage surrounds the scene, and faint buildings appear in the distant background. Printed red text in German appears in the upper left portion of the image, with an additional handwritten number in red ink across it.
